comment: Fixed 1920x1080 capture window; actual tier and world-buffer settings change through the production helper. Display transitions are checked separately. Run with FRAGR_RENDER_DRIVER=vulkan for Forward+ (Ultra needs it) and with the default for Compatibility; inspect both.

states.name: potato
states.note: No MSAA, hard 1024/512 shadows, lamps fade at 24 m, quarter effects budget.

states.name: low
states.note: The earlier Performance preset: no MSAA, smaller shadow maps.

states.name: medium
states.note: The earlier Balanced preset: 2x MSAA, normal shadows.

states.name: ultra
states.note: Forward+: soft high shadows, high SSAO, bounce light. Draws as High on Compatibility.

states.name: fsr1_720
states.note: Actual 720-line world buffer; standard fallback on unsupported renderers.

states.name: fsr2_720
states.note: Inspect sprite edges in the motion strip; FSR2 replaces MSAA on Forward+.

states.name: high_restored
states.note: Native detail restored without restarting the match.
